name: Hwa Chong Institution
summary: Top local independent school with bilingual strength and IP pathways.
body: HCI is a cornerstone of Singapore’s local high-performing secondary/JC landscape, especially for bilingual academic intensity. Relevant to expat families with citizen/PR children navigating DSA and secondary posting — not a fee-paying international alternative for most EP dependants.
waitlistNotes: MOE admissions frameworks — not open international enrolment.
